claims.statement: A benefit for Tom Allen was set for Saturday night, April 30, 1870, at the Theater Comique (old Mozart Hall).
claims.excerpt:
to attend the pugilistic display for the
benefit of Tom Allen, the renowned prize-fighter.

claims.statement: A $1000 championship belt was to be presented to Tom Allen at the benefit, and Joe Coburn, Mike McCoole and others were to put on the gloves.
claims.excerpt:
belt would be presented to Allen, and that Joe Co-
burn, Mike McCoole, Tom Allen, and other pugilists

claims.statement: Allen's benefit was postponed until Wednesday night, May 4, 1870, after the Biddle Street sewer caved in before the show.
claims.excerpt:
It was announced that the benefit
was postponed until Wednesday night

notes: Paper dated Sunday May 1, 1870, so the benefit was Saturday April 30. Wednesday is taken as May 4. The sewer collapse and the rest of the page are not about Allen.
